name: Facebook Community Sales OS - Social AIO Runtime
notes: Adds a 3-slot Social AIO Worker Pool (W1/W2/W3), each with its own Client ID, label, enabled state, profile identity, health and latency.
The existing working single Client ID migrates automatically into W1; W2/W3 can be added without re-entering W1.
Worker settings are stored only in Apps Script Document Properties. Client IDs are masked in the UI and never written to Sheet/GitHub.
TEST 3 WORKER verifies Social AIO version/profile and records latency for smart dispatch.

Selected Groups are planned across tested-online workers with load balancing. Column Profile can optionally pin a Group to W1/W2/W3, worker label, or returned Facebook profile; blank/AUTO remains automatic.
The Control Center launches up to three independent google.script.run worker queues concurrently. Each Worker processes its own queue sequentially.
API fetches run concurrently; Sheet dedupe/write is serialized with DocumentLock to avoid duplicate/race corruption.
Worker imports skip repeated full refresh; one FINALIZE pass refreshes leads/group/timeline after all workers finish, then AI can run once for the batch.
Operator UX remains tick Group -> choose 10/15/20/25 -> QUÉT. Worker implementation stays hidden under Advanced Settings.
